# Repository About

The text for this repository's GitHub **About** panel (the ⚙️ next to "About" on the repo page).

## Description

Native macOS app and widget that shows how much AI-agent usage you have left at a glance — Claude Code session and weekly quotas, refreshed by a background agent.

## Topics

`macos` `swift` `swiftui` `widgetkit` `macos-widget` `app-intents` `claude-code` `ai-agents` `usage-tracking` `menubar`

## Apply with the GitHub CLI

```sh
gh repo edit Abhishek-03113/Orbit \
  --description "Native macOS app and widget that shows how much AI-agent usage you have left at a glance — Claude Code session and weekly quotas, refreshed by a background agent." \
  --add-topic macos,swift,swiftui,widgetkit,macos-widget,app-intents,claude-code,ai-agents,usage-tracking,menubar
```
